# liblecore

> Portable C11 kernels for leCore's caller-supplied-vector algebra.

liblecore provides raw HRR bind and unbind, normalization, bundle, cosine,
permutation, deterministic cleanup, batch operations, and mixed f64-query/f32-corpus
scoring. It supports C, C++, Rust, Python, and WebAssembly hosts.

Status: ABI-0 preview. Pin the exact version. liblecore does not generate atoms,
own a vocabulary, choose application policy, or replace the full leCore engine.

Documentation: https://github.com/AnOversizedMooseWithSocks/leCore/tree/main/native/liblecore
Product contract: https://github.com/AnOversizedMooseWithSocks/leCore/blob/main/PRD.md
Source: https://github.com/AnOversizedMooseWithSocks/leCore
